More Than Just Code.

$ whoami — about me

I'm Yasir Hafeez, a final-year Software Engineering student at Mehran University of Engineering & Technology (MUET), SZAB Campus Khairpur Mir's. My focus is data analytics: analysing data, identifying patterns, and turning raw information into clear, meaningful insights.

I build my skills through real work — a remote Data Analysis internship at Rhombix Technologies, where I used Python and Excel to analyse datasets and support data-driven decision-making, and academic projects like RFM customer segmentation in Python and data-preparation practice in Power BI and Power Query.

I'm now preparing for entry-level Data Analyst opportunities, while staying active in my campus tech community — from participating in OpenHack'25 to leading a team at OpenHack'26.
